one_liner_zh: CrowdStrike營收年增25.57%、EPS超預期，雲端資安平台動能延續。
one_liner_en: CrowdStrike grew revenue 25.57% and beat EPS, sustaining cloud-security platform momentum.
ai_view_zh: 訊號正向：25.57%營收年增搭配EPS超標，顯示Falcon平台採用與模組擴張動能強勁、訂閱經濟效益持續累積。短中期成長型資金青睞，但缺乏本益比資料且SaaS估值通常偏高，使股價對淨新增ARR與指引高度敏感。中期關鍵在客戶留存與多模組滲透。追蹤指標：年化經常性收入（ARR）與淨新增ARR、淨收入留存率、訂閱毛利、自由現金流利潤率，以及多模組客戶佔比。
ai_view_en: Signal is positive: 25.57% revenue growth alongside an EPS beat shows strong Falcon platform adoption and module expansion, with subscription economics compounding. Near to mid-term, growth capital favors the name, but absent a P/E and given typically rich SaaS valuations, the stock is highly sensitive to net-new ARR and guidance. Mid-term, customer retention and multi-module penetration are key. Track: ARR and net-new ARR, net revenue retention, subscription gross margin, free-cash-flow margin, and the share of customers on multiple modules.
highlights_zh: EPS 1.10美元，超越預期1.07美元，正向驚喜3.05%
營收13.9億美元，年增25.57%維持高成長
Falcon平台模組交叉銷售推升客戶單位價值
高經常性收入與淨收入留存率支撐獲利能見度
highlights_en: EPS of $1.10 beat the $1.07 estimate, a 3.05% positive surprise
Revenue of $1.39B grew 25.57%, maintaining high growth
Falcon platform module cross-sell lifts per-customer value
High recurring revenue and net retention support earnings visibility
risks_zh: 高評價SaaS股對成長放緩與利率敏感
資安市場競爭激烈，新增ARR增速須持續驗證
歷史系統中斷事件後的客戶信任與留存仍待觀察
risks_en: Highly valued SaaS stock is sensitive to slowing growth and rates
Intense cybersecurity competition means net-new ARR growth needs ongoing validation
Customer trust and retention after the past outage event remain to be watched
